input.summary: Ported saxpy.cu to SYCL 2020 in saxpy_sycl.cpp with no dpct headers, dpct:: helpers, or DPCT_* macros (grep confirmed). The port uses sycl::queue with enable_profiling, sycl::malloc_shared/sycl::free for unified memory, a 1-D nd_range<1> launch (local size 256, global rounded up to a multiple of 256) with an in-kernel bounds check, and event profiling for kernel_ms. The queue uses sycl::default_selector_v because this machine only exposes an OpenCL CPU device, so gpu_selector_v fails. It compiles with icpx -fsycl and no warnings (compile tool, add_dpct_include=false). Numerical check: for n=1048576 and n=1000, the max abs diff against a host C++ reference is 4.77e-07, under the atol 1e-6 bar. Caveat: the reference-checker output format looked inconsistent across runs, so the numerical result rests on that single checker; I did not run the original CUDA binary (no GPU here).
